title: Disposition of Title XIX funds.
bodyText: All earned Title XIX funds collected for community program services under this chapter shall be deposited to the credit of the state general fund.
bodyHtml: §333F-17.5  Disposition of Title XIX funds.  All earned Title XIX funds collected for community program services under this chapter shall be deposited to the credit of the state general fund. [L 1990, c 96, §1; am L 1993, c 280, §39]
